jobs.title: AVP Infosec India
jobs.description:
Synopsis of the role:

Our team in India is seeking an experienced cybersecurity expert to lead the Information Security initiatives, serving as the official RBI-designated authority. Reporting directly to the Regional CISO with reporting access to the Board and Managing Director of India ECIS, you will manage compliance filings alongside regulatory reviews. Operating without direct reports or sales quotas, this position delivers targeted executive governance and regulatory exposure for a seasoned specialist.

What You’ll Do

• Serve as the RBI-designated Head of Information Security (CISO Designate) for India ECIS, acting as the single point of accountability in regulatory examinations and audits.
• Meet all regulatory reporting obligations under the RBI's information security framework, including incident notification within mandated timeframes.
• Coordinate with the matrixed India security team, reporting to the International CISO for Europe, India and the Emerging Markets, on control execution.
• Lead the entity's response to security incidents, ensuring timely escalation, remediation, and regulator communication.
• Liaise with internal and external auditors, examiners, and assessors on information security posture and evidence.

What Experience You Need

• Willing to work from our Mumbai office, at least 4 days a week.
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or security field; a recognized security certification (e.g., CISSP, CISM) preferred.
• 15+ years of progressive information security experience, including prior experience in a security leadership or management role.
• Experience in a regulated industry or organisation, ideally as a designated or accountable security officer before a financial services regulator (RBI, SEBI, or equivalent).
• Tracking record of managing security incidents through to regulatory closure.
• Experience presenting to boards, audit committees, or senior leadership.
• Familiarity with India's data protection and financial-sector regulatory landscape (RBI circulars, CIC-specific rules).
• Experience working in an international or national matrixed team, influencing people not in your direct reporting line.

What Could Set You Apart

• Experience as a designated lead for a regulator, ideally as a InfoSec Lead for a Credit Information Company or NBFC.
• Experience using DAKSH or similar RBI incident-reporting portals.
• Exposure to global or regional security frameworks in a multinational matrix structure.
• Familiarity with Credit Reference Agencies or a comparable global credit bureau's security operating model.
• Board-level communication skills, including experience drafting board papers on security posture.
• Existing relationships with RBI examination teams or Indian financial regulators.
• Experience partnering closely with a InfoSec Leaders or global security function in a shared-services model.

jobs.title: Threat Researcher
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:
• CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
• A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
• CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.
• CloudSEK’s AIVigil is an AI-native Attack Surface Monitoring platform that continuously discovers, monitors, and secures exposed AI infrastructure, MCP servers, leaked AI credentials, vector databases, agentic workflows, and shadow AI across the internet.

Key Milestones:
• 2016: Launched our first product.
• 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
• 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
• 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
• 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
• Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
• 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

What you'll do:

Customer-Centric Incident Support
• Serve as a trusted advisor during critical security incidents, providing actionable threat intelligence to guide customer containment, remediation, and recovery efforts.
• Develop customized incident playbooks and threat briefings to empower clients with proactive, resilient defense strategies.
• Analyze post-incident data to generate tailored executive reports, highlighting adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), lessons learned, and strategic recommendations.
• Triage the CloudSEK product suite to generate and deliver timely, high-fidelity incident reports to customers.

Threat Detection & Analysis
• Execute advanced threat hunting and malware analysis to uncover and mitigate risks relevant to customer environments.
• Collaborate closely with our Customer Success and Engineering teams to refine detection mechanisms and automate threat intelligence workflows.

Product Innovation & AI
• Stay at the forefront of the rapidly evolving AI landscape.
• Formulate, design, and pitch Proof of Concepts (POCs) leveraging AI to continuously enhance the capabilities of the CloudSEK product suite.

Business Growth
• Translate complex technical research into digestible, customer-facing advisories, executive briefings, and threat reports that demonstrate tangible value and support ARR growth.
• Leverage in-house research on dark web activity, exploit chains, and emerging threats to author compelling content (such as blogs and webinars) that cements CloudSEK’s position as an industry thought leader.

Required Skills:
• Application Security: Hands-on experience in application testing (web and mobile).
• OSINT: A solid understanding of Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) gathering and methodologies.
• Deep/Dark Web: Basic experience monitoring, navigating, and investigating deep and dark web forums and marketplaces.
• Core Fundamentals: A strong, foundational understanding of operating systems architecture and networking protocols.
• AI Tooling: The ability to seamlessly leverage the latest AI tools for daily workflow automation and research enhancement.
• Process Automation: A solid understanding of automation principles with a natural knack for streamlining and automating routine daily work to focus on high-impact research.

jobs.title: OT Product Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re Hiring | OT Product Cybersecurity Engineer / Consultant

Company: Quest Global

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 2+ Years

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Job Overview

Quest Global is looking for skilled and passionate OT Product Cybersecurity Engineers / Consultants with 2+ years of experience in Operational Technology (OT) product security, embedded cybersecurity, and compliance assessments.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on knowledge of IEC 62443 standards, industrial cybersecurity, and secure product development practices. The role involves evaluating product security, identifying vulnerabilities, performing gap assessments, and supporting cybersecurity compliance initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
• Conduct OT product cybersecurity assessments and compliance evaluations.
• Evaluate secure product development practices in accordance with IEC 62443-4-1.
• Assess technical security requirements based on IEC 62443-4-2.
• Perform security gap assessments and requirements evaluations.
• Support cybersecurity initiatives for industrial and embedded products.
• Assess security aspects of industrial communication protocols.
• Identify security gaps and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.

Required Skills & Expertise
• 2+ years of experience in OT Product Cybersecurity or Embedded Cybersecurity.
• Knowledge of IEC 62443-4-1 – Secure Product Development Lifecycle.
• Understanding of IEC 62443-4-2 – Technical Security Requirements.
• Experience in OT product security and compliance assessments.
• Knowledge of industrial communication protocols:
• Modbus
• DNP3
• OPC UA
• IEC 61850
• Understanding of security requirements evaluation and gap assessments.
• Knowledge of industrial control systems and embedded security concepts.

Preferred Educational Qualification

Graduates from National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU) or Gujarat Forensic Sciences University (GFSU) are preferred.

Job Details
• Position: OT Product Cybersecurity Engineer / Consultant
• Company: Quest Global
• Work Location: Hyderabad
• Experience: 2+ Years
• Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred

How to Apply?

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at:

Email: Vamsi.Potharlanka@quest-global.com

Know someone with relevant OT cybersecurity expertise? Feel free to share this opportunity or refer suitable candidates!

jobs.title: Security Consultant-AI-Driven Threat Management
jobs.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Security Consultant specializing in Intelligence & Operations, you play a crucial role in helping Client IT understand and address key security issues, exposures, and vulnerabilities. Your expertise in security intelligence and operations enables you to articulate effective security strategies and mitigation measures.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

• Develop Security Strategies: Apply security principles, counter-threat intelligence, and knowledge of security intelligence and operations to develop and recommend effective security strategies, programs, plans, and mitigation measures.
• Enhance Security Posture: Utilize proactive threat hunting and intelligence-driven defense strategies to enhance Client IT's security posture.
• Articulate IBM's SIOC and SIEM: Clearly communicate IBM's Security Intelligence and Operations Center (SIOC) and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) points of view, including financial implications.
• Leverage Threat Intelligence: Apply hands-on experience with tools like QRadar to analyze and mitigate various cyber threats.
• Collaborate with Clients: Work closely with Client IT to understand their security needs and deliver tailored security solutions.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

• Security Intelligence Knowledge: Exposure to security intelligence and operations, enabling articulation of effective security strategies and mitigation measures.
• Threat Analysis Experience: Hands-on experience with tools like QRadar to analyze and mitigate various cyber threats.
• Counter-Threat Intelligence: Exposure to counter-threat intelligence principles and practices to inform security strategy development.
• Security Strategy Development: Experience working with security principles to develop and recommend effective security strategies, programs, plans, and mitigation measures.
• Cyber Threat Understanding: Familiarity with various cyber threats and their potential impact on security posture.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

• Advanced Threat Analysis Tools: Exposure to utilizing tools beyond QRadar for analyzing and mitigating complex cyber threats, further enhancing threat intelligence capabilities.
• Cybersecurity Frameworks: Familiarity with industry-recognized cybersecurity frameworks, allowing for more comprehensive security strategy development and mitigation measures.
• Financial Impact Analysis: Experience with assessing the financial implications of security threats and vulnerabilities, informing more effective security investment decisions.

jobs.title: Information Security (ISMS) Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Avensys is a reputed global IT professional services company headquartered in Singapore. Our service spectrum includes enterprise solution consulting, business intelligence, business process automation and managed services. Given our decade of success we have evolved to become one of the top trusted providers in Singapore and service a client base across banking and financial services, insurance, information technology, healthcare, retail and supply chain.

We are currently looking to hire Information Security (ISMS) Implementation Specialist This is an exciting opportunity to expand your skill set, achieve job satisfaction and work-life balance. More details as below.

Notice Period: Immediate-15 days

Contract: Longterm Contract

Work: UAE-Hybrid

Exp:10+ Years

Job Description Job Summary:

Position Overview

We are seeking an Information Security (ISMS) Implementation Specialist to support the execution of our Information Security Action Plan. The role focuses on hands-on implementation and operational execution of security processes in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS) and corporate standards.

This is a non-strategic, execution-focused role, requiring a reliable professional who can deliver assigned tasks on time with strong commitment and accuracy.

Required Profile

Core Requirements
• Solid understanding of ISMS / ISO/IEC 27001 principles and controls
• Practical experience in ISMS implementation, preferably in a large scale company (i.e. approximately 1,000 employees)
• Proven track record of playing a leading or key execution role in ISMS initiatives
• Strong execution capability with a high level of commitment to deadlines and task completion
• Proficient in English (written and verbal)

Preferred (Optional)
• Hands-on experience with IT infrastructure (PCs, servers, and network devices)
• ISMS Implementer certification or equivalent qualification

Not Required
• Strategic planning capabilities
• Large-scale program or project management leadership
• Proposal for a Customized ISMS Implementation Approach (by own experience)

Key Responsibilities

1. Cybersecurity Awareness Training follow-up
• Aggregate and analyze results of cybersecurity awareness training (including phishing simulations and e-learning)
• Conduct follow-ups to ensure completion and improvement

2. Security Incident Response Procedure Implementation
• Educate IT members on Global/Local security incident response procedures
• Promote awareness local activity and adoption across the organization

3. Vulnerability Management Process Implementation
• Understand corporate vulnerability management processes
• Identify and define local-specific procedures
• Implement and integrate processes into local IT operations
• Execute ongoing vulnerability management activities

4. Cybersecurity resilience Backup & Recovery
• Understand corporate backup management standards
• Current Backup & Recovery State Assessment
• Gap Analysis vs HQ Backup Standard
• Define Minimal Improvement Actions (Fit-for-Purpose)
• Perform restore testing and document results

5. Implement Asset management process (for local scope)
• Understand corporate digital asset management processes
• Gap Analysis Against Current Operations (Reality-Based)
• Identify local procedural needs
• Lightweight Documentation of Local Processes (including Unauthorized Software Inventory & removing process)
• Implement and operate within local IT workflows

6. Onboarding Risk management process (for local asset)
• Understand DENV existing process and procedure
• Register local asset risk (where needs)

7. Access control reviews and remediations (for local asset)
• Understand corporate access control processes
• Define and implement local procedures
• Ensure execution within IT operations

8. Security Maturity Assessment
• Prepare and submit evidence for security maturity assessments

9. Knowledge Transfer
• Provide structured knowledge transfer to internal IT members
• Ensure sustainability of implemented processes

Key Competencies
• Strong execution and delivery mindset
• Detail-oriented with high accuracy and accountability
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
• Practical and hands-on problem-solving skills
• Effective communication and coordination skills

Outcome Expectations
• Successful implementation of priority ISMS processes
• Measurable improvement in operational security practices
• Completed deliverables within defined timeline
• Clear documentation and knowledge transfer to internal teams

WHAT’S ON OFFER:

You will be remunerated with an excellent base salary and entitled to attractive company benefits. Additionally, you will get the opportunity to enjoy a fun and collaborative work environment, alongside a strong career progression.

To submit your application, please apply online or email your UPDATED CV in Microsoft Word format to varra@aven-sys.com Your interest will be treated with strict confidentiality.

Avensys Consulting Pte Ltd EA Licence 12C5759
